description: Run a batch (OpenAI's /batches shape) over an uploaded batch file on a base model or your ft: model. endpoint: "/v1/chat/completions" (default) or "/v1/embeddings". completion_window: "24h" (default) or Gridline's looser "72h". Costs credit: a batch is charged per 1M input and output tokens at the model's published batch price, and at least the model's per-batch minimum (https://gridlinegpu.com/pricing). A batch whose upper bound your credit cannot cover is refused before it runs. Requires confirm_spend: true.

confirm_spend.description: Must be true for this call to run: you have read the quote or price and accept the charge.

input_file_id.description: File id of the batch input (purpose batch).

name: create_batch
title: Create a batch
